findings.evidence: Lines 461-498: `extra_declarations: Iterable[tuple[int, str]]`, `keep: Callable[[Declaration], bool] | None`; lines 486 and 493 implement the undocumented dropping/rooting rules.
findings.fix: Document both keyword parameters and the `_root_.`/unnamed-declaration behaviour, at the level of detail the other public functions in this module get.
findings.issue: `qualified_declarations` is the new public API this PR adds, but its one-line docstring documents neither `extra_declarations` (what the `int` and `str` in each pair mean — source offset and declaration name, ordered against scope events) nor `keep`, and does not state that unnamed declarations and `_root_.`-rooted names are handled specially.

findings.evidence: `_declaration_tail` (line 281) sets `start = position` before binder scanning and returns `text[start:header_end]`; `_declaration_returns_sort` (line 507) relies on finding the top-level colon inside that same string.
findings.fix: Describe `header` as the declaration header from after the name through the body introducer (binders plus result type).
findings.issue: `Declaration`'s docstring labels the fields in order and calls `header` "result text", but `_declaration_tail` returns the slice starting immediately after the name, so `header` contains the binders as well as the result type — misleading for consumers of the now-public dataclass.

summary: The extraction copies the old lint docstring into the new shared module without adapting it: the module docstring overclaims plural consumers and never describes the reusable parser API it exists to expose, the test module still says it tests the old script, and the PR's headline new public function has a one-line docstring that leaves its non-obvious parameters undocumented.
